releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.5.0 (Flagship Camera & Filter Overhaul)
changelog:
🚀 Flagship Pro Release v10.5.0:
• 1-Click Auto-Crop Green Line: Camera now locks vibrant emerald green border, animated laser sweep, and automatically rectifies document directly into clean page on snap!
• Multi-Scale Document Filters: Resolution-independent illumination division erases shadows, halos, and makes paper 100% studio white with razor-sharp black text.
• 12MP Crystal Camera Clarity: Full sensor resolution preserved with 4096px decoding and 96% JPEG compression quality.
• AI Neural Passport Studio: On-device ML Kit selfie background replacement (White, Light Blue, Deep Blue, Red, Gray).
• Micro-Toner Paper Texture Blending: In-place text editor blends toner grain and edge bleed for 100% printed paper realism.
• Advanced Typography: Dedicated Typewriter, Dot-Matrix, Consolas, and Devanagari Hindi support.
• OpenXML Excel Engine: Multi-cell merges and complex table header support.
• 3D Book Dewarping: Binding gutter leveling and curvature flattening.
• Direct Gallery Save: Batch resizer and converters save directly to device gallery.
